name: Being An Example
overview: Scripture calls believers to live as distinct examples in the world, embodying godly character and influence. Proverbs instructs the faithful to guide others, especially children, in the right way so they remain steadfast in righteousness. Jesus teaches that His followers are the salt and light of the earth, meant to preserve goodness and visibly reflect God's glory through their good works. This example points others to the saving love of God demonstrated through Christ, encouraging faith and eternal life.
